A checked-in observation.svg still contains generated-looking old binding text, but the authoritative StructureDefinition is correct and diagram-only hand edits are not appropriate for this reconciliation.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current active source already implements the requested removal and no source edit is needed.
